records.name: Maps as Leverage

objectiveTruth.statement: A Black Feathers intermediary network is the principal buyer of recent East Transit Spine maps and route revisions, collecting fresh route intelligence because disruption and uncertainty increase the value of accurate movement information.
doesNotEstablish: Black Feathers caused Eastern Bridge damage.
Black Feathers caused East Route Beacon degradation.
Any East Gate official is compromised.
Midbay is uninvolved in other disruption-related activity.

requiredRevelations.R1: Someone is systematically purchasing unusually current East Transit Spine maps/revisions.
requiredRevelations.R2: The procurement values current access conditions, closures, inspection/patrol patterns and workarounds.
requiredRevelations.R3: Purchases are compartmentalized across brokers/sellers, indicating an organized information-gathering network.
requiredRevelations.R4: The purchasing network is associated with Black Feathers.

R5.statement: The intelligence is accumulated for downstream clients/leverage.

records.primaryConclusion: Black Feathers is the principal map-buyer network.

competingHypothesis.proposition: The Midbay Outfit may be exploiting the disruption and therefore plausibly benefits from closure or degraded official access.
cannotEstablish: Midbay is the principal map buyer
competingHypothesis.retentionRule: Black Feathers resolution does not rewrite independent Midbay activity as fabricated false evidence.
competingHypothesis.sourceReference: Vertigon.PDF p.49: Midbay Outfit controls smuggling and unregistered shipping lanes.

records.truthBeliefEvidencePolicy: Objective truth, observation, claim, evidence, hypothesis, source reliability, reveal state and Player knowledge remain separately typed.

records.name: East-Spine Revision Sale Note
records.contentSummary: A route-chart seller's retained sale note records that a recurring intermediary offered a clearly higher price for an East Transit Spine revision updated after the current disruption than for older editions.
establishes: fresh revisions are valued above older copies
procurement focuses on current East Transit Spine information

records.name: Current-Conditions Annotation Request
records.content: Mark the current East Gate access restrictions, closure points, inspection windows, and usable workarounds. Leave general district detail out. Do not bundle alternate-passage notes with this copy; another runner is collecting those.
establishes: another intermediary collects a different slice

records.role: information broker who regularly observes route-information transactions in the Listening Market
